description: Keyword ranks for one app in one App Store / Google Play country. THREE STATES ARE DISTINCT: measured=false means the query could not be measured, rank=null means it was measured but the app is absent from the top results, rank=<number> is the rank. Never collapse them into one — counting an unmeasured day as zero produces a false answer.

country.description: country code, e.g. tr, us (defaults to the app's first country)

name: get_keywords
